recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if Patient Care later makes a final decision to add or rename AllergyIntolerance onset search parameters; currently discovered related issues do not change this outcome.
issue_request: FHIR-17592 was a Published FHIR-core Patient Care change request. The original request proposed changing the onset search parameter expression from AllergyIntolerance.reaction.onset to AllergyIntolerance.reaction.onset.as(dateTime), but the final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution was to remove the existing AllergyIntolerance.reaction.onset search parameter and not add any new AllergyIntolerance.onset search parameters.
initial_application: HL7/fhir commit 1f77a6e14e528ce5275d0ab0af27c2d4b56425f4 explicitly applied GF#17592 by changing the old AllergyIntolerance spreadsheet search-parameter row from onset to !onset. The 2021 source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 removed the spreadsheet and introduced the current bundle-AllergyIntolerance-search-params.xml without reintroducing an onset search parameter.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/allergyintolerance/bundle-AllergyIntolerance-search-params.xml is current build-scope source. The resource still has AllergyIntolerance.onset[x] and AllergyIntolerance.reaction.onset elements, but the active SearchParameter bundle lists no onset, onset-date, onset-age, onset-info, or reaction-onset SearchParameter. Jira/community searches found older element-modeling context and a later triaged reaction.onset modeling issue, but no final later decision requiring a current AllergyIntolerance onset search parameter.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current source already reflects the final Jira resolution.
